title: S109 7.4 Mail Rerouting Based on the 251 and 551 Response Codes
parent_path: S109 7.4 Mail Rerouting Based on the 251 and 551 Response Codes

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Before a client uses the 251 or 551 reply codes from a RCPT command to automatically update its future behavior (e.g., updating the user's address book), it should be certain of the server's authenticity.
statements.trigger: receipt of 251 or 551 reply to RCPT command
actions: update user address book or future rerouting behavior
